# api-lifecycle

Lifecycle from draft to deprecation - contract-first, dated deprecation, measured retirement.

## Detected anti-patterns

### `AF-BREAK-005` — Deprecation is dated, announced and measurable (medium)

"Deprecated" without a sunset date and a consumer signal never finishes; RFC 9745 `Deprecation`/`Sunset` headers plus docs let consumers see the deadline and operators see the countdown.

Remediation: Emit `Deprecation: true` and `Sunset: <http-date>` on deprecated operations; announce in release notes; measure remaining traffic before removal.

Reference: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9745

### `AF-BREAK-006` — Semantic-version the contract, not the implementation (medium)

Consumers reason about the API surface, not internals — major bumps for breaking changes, minor for additions, patch for clarifications; reusing an implementation version confuses that signal.

Remediation: Version the contract document independently; bump `info.version` per the change class `diff contract` reports.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-agentic-platform.md

### `AF-CONTRACT-001` — Contract operation has no implementation (high)

A contract operation without a matching code route means clients can call an endpoint the service does not serve.

Remediation: Implement the route or remove the operation from the contract.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-design.md
